sloka: शुक्लैः च वाल व्यजनैः धूयमानैः समंततः ।शंख भेरी निनादैः च वन्दिभिः च अभिवन्दितः ॥४-३८-१३॥
transliteration: śuklaiḥ ca vāla vyajanaiḥ dhūyamānaiḥ samaṁtataḥ ।śaṁkha bherī ninādaiḥ ca vandibhiḥ ca abhivanditaḥ ॥4-38-13॥

translations.english: With a pale white umbrella over his head, white yaktail fans and sounds of conches and drums, Sugriva set out receiving greetings from monkeys, rejoicing in his royal glory.
translations.hindi: उनके ऊपर सफेद बालों का चँवर भी डुलाया जाता था । शङ्ख: आर नगाडे बज रहे थे। बन्दीगण बिरुदावली पढ़ते जाते ये
